$comment: Controlled vocabularies shared by every pack. Add a value only with a CONTENT_MODEL.md entry explaining it; never rename one (IDs and compiled bundles depend on them).

assertion.stated: printed in the source at the cited page
assertion.derived: follows from stated facts by a named rule (rule id required)
assertion.editorial: written by the project (summaries, labels); never shown as source text

review.source-compared: checked against the page image by the project
review.reviewed: approved by a reviewer with curriculum authority

strand.decoding: डिकोडिंग / Decoding (Hindi four-block model; not a NIPUN strand)
strand.shapes-space: आकृतियाँ और स्थानिक समझ / Shapes and space
strand.data-patterns: पैटर्न और आँकड़े / Patterns and data

weekKind.school-readiness: विद्या प्रवेश / school readiness (Hindi G1 weeks 1–8)

routineType.oral-language: talk, picture chart, experience, poem, story poster
routineType.decoding: letter, akshar, matra, blending, word and sentence reading, grids
routineType.reading: model, shared, logographic, independent, fluent reading
routineType.writing: emergent, dictation, related and expressive writing
routineType.instruction: Math शिक्षण योजना: conversation and GRR (I do / we do / you do)
routineType.assessment: मैंने सीख लिया and other assessments

materialType.poster: कविता / कहानी / चित्र कहानी / गणित पोस्टर

sectionKind.admin: cover, credits, contents, anthem: shown only as original pages
sectionKind.program: program-level guidance (goals, year map, cycle, periods, materials, usage)
sectionKind.resources: stories, poems, grids, sample questions, kit
